Hmm not sure about this one, but on a plain new install of macosx 10.9

```
→ python -V
Python 2.7.5
```

Asking for the help

```
→ http -h
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/http", line 5, in <module>

```

The libraries are here.

```
→ sudo pip install --upgrade httpie
Requirement already up-to-date: httpie in /Library/Python/2.7/site-packages
```

A request maybe? No luck.

body: `$ pip install httpie` should now work on Mavericks as well. Fixed by adding support for Python wheel packages.

For the record, the initial issue is fixed better if you upgrade setuptools

``` bash
pip install --upgrade setuptools
```

Confirmed here:
https://github.com/hhatto/autopep8/commit/0acd5dcaba5f41f9a51d40d20d008b4e0d2417b8
